attr.title: muSudoku
attr.desc: Sudoku graded Easy to Master, plus three more logic puzzles: Solo (shade cells so no number repeats), Pairlink (join matching numbers with lines that fill the board) and Hoshi (join numbered islands with bridges). Every puzzle is made on the device with exactly one solution and graded by the techniques needed to solve it. Pen and pencil notes, undo and redo, optional explained hints, nine themes, statistics and puzzle packs.
